title: Settings
providerIntro: Pick an AI tool installed on your computer and it sorts your spending into categories and writes ways to save. Without one, installments, payments and my own suggestions still work.
providerUnavailable: This tool is not running on this computer right now.
example: Amounts and dates look like this: {{amount}}, {{date}}.
errNetwork: I cannot reach the local server; the setting was not saved.
ratesIntro: For the minimum payment plan I use the legal maximums and the rate printed on your statement. If your bank charges you a different rate, enter it here.
ratesFileNone: No value in the data file
ratesInvalidRate: Write the monthly percent in figures, for example 3.08.
ratesInvalidShare: Write a percent between 0 and 100, for example 15.
ratesWhere: Where a field is empty I use the rate printed on your statement first, then the data file. A value you enter comes before both.
ratesRejected: The server did not accept these values. Check the format.
ratesReset: I went back to the default rates.
passwordsIntro: Passwords stay in your computer's password store (keyring). Here you only see which banks I remember a password for.
passwordsNoKeyring: I found no password store (keyring) on this computer. I will ask for the password of every protected statement.
passwordsGone: No password was remembered for this bank.
privacy1: I read and store your statement on this computer. The local server only listens on 127.0.0.1.
privacy2: Card number, name, address, IBAN and customer number are removed before anything is stored.
privacy3: The tool you choose only receives the date, description, amount, currency and kind of each transaction, plus totals the code computed.
privacy4: Code computes totals and installments; the model does not produce figures.
privacy5: kalan is open source (MIT licence). You can check what is written here by reading the code.
providerEffect: {{name}} is selected. It reads your statements one by one, sorts your spending into categories, then writes suggestions. It also reads every new statement you upload; the strip under the menu shows its progress.
providerSent: The tool receives the date, description, amount, currency and type of each transaction in your statements; for suggestions it receives only totals (category totals, regular payments, places you spend at often, installment load).
cardsIntro: The cards I found on your statements. Give one a name and every screen shows that name.
cardFailed: I could not save the name. Try again in a moment.
